title: Severe waterlogging in Surat Varachha area after heavy overnight rains
text_snippet: Surat Varachha main road is completely submerged in 3 feet water! Vehicles stranded and shops flooded. Tapi river level rising fast. Local emergency teams helping people. SuratRain GujaratFlood Surat

title: Ukai Dam releases 1.8 lakh cusecs into Tapi river, flood alert sounded in Surat low-lying zones
text_snippet: Following torrential downpours in catchment areas, authorities opened gates of Ukai Dam. Tapi river flowing near danger mark in Surat. Surat Municipal Corporation deployed dewatering pumps and evacuated 250 residents from Rander and Varachha causeway

title: CRITICAL ALERT: Flood Warning for Surat City and Olpad Taluka
text_snippet: OFFICIAL ALERT from Gujarat State Disaster Management Authority GSDMA : High flood warning issued for Surat city, Adajan, Rander, Varachha, and Olpad taluka along Tapi basin. NDRF 6th Battalion deployed. Public warned against approaching causeway.

title: Massive gale force winds and tidal waves hitting Mandvi port in Kutch
text_snippet: Severe cyclone conditions near Mandvi and Mundra port in Kutch! Trees uprooted on Bhuj-Mandvi highway, power lines snapped. Stay indoors! CycloneAlert Kutch Mandvi Gujarat

title: Deep Depression over Arabian Sea intensifies: IMD sounds Cyclone Red Alert for Kutch and Devbhumi Dwarka
text_snippet: The deep depression has intensified into a cyclonic storm approaching coastal Kutch and Saurashtra. Wind gusts up to 90 kmph reported at Kandla, Mandvi and Dwarka. District Collector Bhuj orders closure of schools and fishing activities suspended.

title: OFFICIAL WARNING: IMD Red Alert for Kutch and Saurashtra Coasts
text_snippet: OFFICIAL BULLETIN: IMD Regional Centre Ahmedabad issues RED ALERT for Kutch, Devbhumi Dwarka, and Jamnagar. Very severe cyclonic winds and heavy to very heavy rainfall expected. SDRF and Coast Guard deployed along coastal belt.

title: Huge fire outbreak at chemical factory in Vatva GIDC Ahmedabad
text_snippet: Massive black smoke billowing from Vatva GIDC Phase 4 chemical factory in Ahmedabad. 15 fire tenders rushed to spot. Toxic fumes spreading to Narol highway. Ahmedabad Fire GIDC Emergency

title: Major fire at chemical packaging unit in Vatva Ahmedabad; 18 fire brigades engaged in firefighting
text_snippet: A major blaze erupted at an industrial unit in Vatva GIDC Ahmedabad on Sunday afternoon. Chief Fire Officer Jayesh Khadia stated that foam tenders are being used to contain solvent barrels from exploding. No casualties reported yet.

title: Dilapidated two-storey building collapses in Rajkot old city area; rescue operations underway
text_snippet: A two-storey residential structure collapsed in Dhebar Road area of Rajkot following heavy seepage from continuous rain. 4 persons trapped inside debris rescued by Rajkot Municipal Fire Brigade and admitted to civil hospital. SDRF called in for searc

title: Vishwamitri river crosses 26 feet danger mark in Vadodara
text_snippet: Vishwamitri river has breached warning level at Kala Ghoda bridge in Vadodara! Water entered Fatehgunj and Sayajiganj streets. Crocodiles spotted near residential societies! Everyone please be careful. VadodaraRains VadodaraFlood Baroda
